Raising LimitNPROC is an OS limit (PF §4.3) and is not allowed as a mitigation.
PROPOSED (Class B, needs your APPROVED record, you are not the executor):
 1) vl-streamroute-asg: MinSize/DesiredCapacity 132->120 by terminating the 12 hosts added today (sr-{a,b,c}-041..044), with decrement. MaxSize stays 150. This is PLAT-2291's own rollback.
 2) Delete scheduled action bf-capacity-hold on vl-streamroute-asg. Otherwise it puts 132 back at 14:00 today. Elena will be told.
